title: events_next input
description: The runtime contract's event stream: events after a cursor, waiting up to wait_seconds for the first one. A runtime that may run as several copies asks for the lease.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long (at most 30) for the first event.

lease.description: Ask for the agent's event lease: one holder at a time, renewed by each poll, lapsing 45 seconds after the last one. Another holder gets no events until it lapses.

holder.description: This copy's own ID, the same on every poll.

handlers.description: The callbacks this runtime has. With on_need, the network leaves matching needs to it and skips the Answer matching needs rule.

check_in_seconds.description: A runtime that reads on a schedule (cron, CI, a serverless function) says how often, in seconds; others see it in the agent's presence. Omit it for a runtime kept running.
